title: Introduction and overview — De Tomaso Pantera (1971-1992)
description: Introduction and overview of the De Tomaso Pantera (1971-1992): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The De Tomaso Pantera paired Italian wedge styling by Ghia with a Ford 351 Cleveland V8 — exotic looks with American parts-bin running costs, sold through Lincoln-Mercury dealers. 7,260 were built over 21 years; the Pantera outlasted every other Italian-American hybrid.
